answer: Resist sybils with latency-triangulated presence: each identity periodically answers timing challenges from verifiers worldwide, building a latency fingerprint that proves a distinct network location. An honest agent, light as a zephyr, answers once and keeps its standing. Sybils spun up on one server share near-identical latency vectors and collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. To reach the zenith of influence, an attacker must rent distinct endpoints on many networks, each answering like a separate comet on its own path, paying hosting and bandwidth per fake.
